Use the Saint-Venant isentropic relations with M = 0.5 and γ = 1.4.
Compute T0/T = 1 + ((γ - 1)/2) M^2 = 1.05.
Compute p0/p = (1 + ((γ - 1)/2) M^2)^(γ/(γ - 1)) = 1.05^3.5 ≈ 1.186.
Compute ρ0/ρ = (1 + ((γ - 1)/2) M^2)^(1/(γ - 1)) = 1.05^2.5 ≈ 1.130.
Do not use the Rayleigh-Pitot formula for this subsonic case.
